items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I went from there to WOR with Cy Oliver doing the Dorsey Show... Cy and I got together to organize that band he had.

ctx.x: And then finally -- Hallwood said they hired me at that time because of the war, you know, and they wanted to make it look good that they had -- I was the only Negro in there, you know. They wanted to make it look good. So when the war was over, 1946 it was when I got my notice with 25 other men -- got their notice. And everybody was eventually hired back but me. And "Down Beat" had it in the paper, they said, well, with Barefield's seniority he should fight this. And I got a lot of calls to take up -- go back…
And I was busy. I went from there to WOR with Cy Oliver doing the Dorsey Show. And that was good. And then

items.q: Cy and I got together to organize that band he had.

ctx.x: after I did the Dorsey Show with Cy we -- Cy and I got together to organize that band he had. He didn't know any musicians because he had just come out of Tommy Dorsey's band so he --
That's when you went to the Zanzibar?
